description: Drafter-led pre-submission triage. Drop in a PDF, get back a one-page triage sheet against the project's accumulated knowledge.

services.name: Supabase Project URL
services.description: Your Supabase project URL — stores projects, registers, drafter tokens.
instructions: Create a project — pick the region nearest you, set a database password, name it (e.g. 'preflight')
Copy the URL — looks like https://abcxyz.supabase.co
services.costNote: Free tier covers most use. Pro $25/mo if you scale.

services.name: Supabase Anon Key
services.description: Public anon key for client-side Supabase calls.
instructions: Copy the 'anon' / 'public' key (long JWT starting with 'eyJ...')

services.name: Supabase Service Role Key
services.description: Server-side admin key — bypasses RLS. Keep secret.
instructions: Same Supabase project — Settings → API → 'service_role' key (click 'Reveal')
Copy — another long JWT. Never expose to client-side code or commit to git.

services.name: Anthropic
services.description: Claude API — drives the manual-check LLM rows in the register (Sonnet) and ambiguity classification (Haiku).
instructions: Sign up or log in to Anthropic Console
services.costNote: Pay-as-you-go. Most projects run < $5/mo at moderate usage.

services.name: OpenRouter
services.description: Alternative to direct Anthropic — single key for multiple providers, consolidated billing.
instructions: Keys → Create Key — starts with sk-or-

services.name: OpenAI
instructions: API Keys → Create new secret key — starts with sk-
services.costNote: Embeddings are cheap (~$0.02 per million tokens). Budget < $1/mo for moderate KBs.

services.name: Resend
services.description: Outbound notifications (drafter-link emails, daily summary) + inbound webhook for project correspondence ingestion.
instructions: Sign up at resend.com and verify a sending domain
API Keys → Create API Key — starts with re_

services.name: Resend Inbound Webhook Secret
services.description: Shared secret for the inbound-email webhook (parses planner / engineer / Council correspondence into the project KB).

services.name: Google OAuth Client ID
services.description: Google Drive integration — pull project source documents directly from a project Drive folder.
instructions: Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Create OAuth client ID

services.name: Google OAuth Client Secret
services.description: Companion secret to the Google OAuth Client ID.
instructions: Same Google Cloud Console credential — copy the Client Secret

services.name: Google OAuth Redirect URI
services.description: Must match what you registered in Google Cloud Console.

services.name: ElevenLabs
services.description: Voice agent per VOICE AI STANDARD RULE — agent provisioning deferred to follow-up turn. Leave blank for v0.
services.costNote: Pay-as-you-go. Budget $5-20/mo depending on voice usage.

services.name: ElevenLabs Agent ID
services.description: Auto-created on first run (deferred). Leave blank for v0.

services.name: Cron Secret
services.description: Random string protecting /api/cron/* endpoints from public invocation.

services.name: Drafter Token Secret
services.description: HMAC secret for signing per-project drafter URLs (short-lived). Rotating this revokes every outstanding drafter link.

services.name: App URL
services.description: Where this Preflight instance is deployed (e.g. https://preflight.vercel.app).
